title: Replace milestone checkbox progress with manual slider control

requirements.summary: Remove all checkbox-based progress tracking functionality from MilestoneSection and TaskCard components
acceptanceCriteria: No checkboxes are displayed for milestone or task completion
TaskCard components no longer include completion toggle controls
MilestoneSection header click behavior is disabled

file_operations.description: Remove the clickable header behavior that toggles completion of all tasks within the milestone. Remove all console logging related to toggle interactions. Keep the expandable card structure but disable the completion toggle functionality.

Remove the checkbox input control for task completion. Remove all event handlers related to task completion toggling. Remove completion state management logic. Keep the task display structure, edit button, notes textarea, and due date information intact.

Remove or simplify the component since task-level completion status is no longer tracked. This component may be repurposed or removed entirely depending on whether any visual indicators are still needed.

requirements.summary: Add a manual slider control to each milestone card that allows direct adjustment of progress percentage from 0% to 100%
acceptanceCriteria: Each milestone displays a horizontal slider input
Slider range is 0-100 representing percentage completion
Current progress percentage value is displayed next to the slider
Slider is fully interactive and responsive to user input

file_operations.description: Add a horizontal slider input control to the milestone card header or body. The slider should have a range of 0-100 representing percentage completion. Display the current progress percentage value next to the slider (e.g., '45%'). Connect the slider to the updateMilestoneProgress mutation from useTasks hook. Ensure the slider is styled consistently with the warm earth-tones color scheme and is fully interactive.

requirements.summary: Create React Query mutation hook in useTasks that calls the backend updateMilestoneProgress method when slider value changes
acceptanceCriteria: Mutation successfully calls backend actor method
Mutation invalidates progress-related queries on success
Optimistic updates show immediate slider movement

file_operations.description: Add a new React Query mutation called updateMilestoneProgress that accepts milestoneId (bigint) and progress (bigint) parameters. The mutation should call actor.updateMilestoneProgress(milestoneId, progress). On success, invalidate queries related to milestones and progress calculations to trigger refetch. Implement optimistic updates to show immediate slider movement before backend confirmation. Return the mutation function for use in components.

requirements.summary: Update progressUtils.ts to calculate phase and overall progress based on manually set milestone progress percentages instead of task completion counts
acceptanceCriteria: Phase progress is calculated as average of milestone progress values within that phase
Overall progress is calculated as average of all milestone progress values
Progress bars and percentages update immediately when slider values change
Calculations ignore task completion status entirely

file_operations.description: Rewrite all progress calculation functions to use the manually set milestone.progress field instead of counting completed tasks. Calculate phase progress as the average of milestone progress percentages for milestones within that phase. Calculate overall progress as the average of all milestone progress percentages. Remove all logic that references task completion status. Ensure functions accept milestone data with progress fields and return percentage values.

Update to use the new progress calculation functions from progressUtils that work with milestone progress percentages. Ensure the progress bar and percentage display reflect the manually set values and update immediately when slider values change.

Update phase progress indicators to use the new calculation functions from progressUtils that work with milestone progress percentages instead of task completion counts. Ensure progress badges update immediately when milestone slider values change.

requirements.summary: Remove all completeTask mutation calls, task completion state management, and checkbox-related event handlers from the frontend codebase
acceptanceCriteria: useTasks hook no longer includes completeTask mutation
TaskCard component has no completion toggle logic
No click handlers remain for task or milestone completion
All checkbox-related console logging is removed

file_operations.description: Remove the completeTask mutation entirely from the useTasks hook. Remove all related query invalidation logic that was triggered by task completion. Remove all console logging statements related to task completion. Keep all other task management mutations (add, edit, notes) intact.

Remove all completion toggle logic, click handlers, and state management related to task completion. Remove any console logging related to checkbox interactions. Keep the task display structure, edit functionality, notes management, and due date display fully functional.

Remove all click handlers for milestone completion toggling. Remove all console logging statements related to toggle interactions. Ensure the component no longer attempts to mark all tasks within a milestone as complete/incomplete.
